title: ship.config.json
description: Per-app identity manifest for the shipkit pipeline. One file per repo, at the repo root. Every ship command resolves paths and IDs through here; nothing else may hardcode an app.

name.description: Human-facing app name. Used in output only; the App Store name lives in the staged listing.

bundleId.description: Production iOS bundle identifier. Must match the binary EAS builds and the app RevenueCat is configured against.

version.description: Marketing version override. Omit to read expo.version from app.json, which is the usual case.

appDir.description: Directory containing app.json / eas.json / package.json, relative to the repo root. Repos that nest the Expo app set this (e.g. "mobile").

appId.description: App Store Connect numeric app id. Find it with `asc apps list`. Null until the app exists in ASC.

profile.description: Named `asc auth` credential to use. Null uses the default profile.

primaryLocale.description: Source locale. Shared URLs fall back to this locale's staged listing.

profile.description: eas.json build profile used by `ship build`.

channel.description: EAS Update channel/branch used by `ship ota`.

dir.description: Root of the listing tree: staged/ (authored) plus app-info/ and version/<v>/ (generated — never hand-edit).

locales.description: ASC locales this app ships. Informational; the staged directory is the real source.

projectId.description: RevenueCat v2 project id, e.g. projf0d996da.

appId.description: RevenueCat app id for the App Store app.

entitlement.description: Entitlement lookup_key gating paid features. `ship rc audit` fails when it is missing from the project.

keyEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the public SDK key the app reads at runtime, e.g. EXPO_PUBLIC_RC_IOS_KEY. Name only — never the value.

orgId.description: Apple Ads org id. Credentials are separate from App Store Connect.

dir.description: Where `ship ads plan` writes campaign plans.
Keyword research artifacts, one subdirectory per locale.

seeds.description: Seed terms for autocomplete harvesting. Empty derives them from the primary listing's name and subtitle.

privacyUrl.description: Published privacy policy. `ship preflight` HEAD-requests it — a dead URL is an automatic review rejection.
